senses.gloss: f. (ἀγγαρεία, angaria) forced labor, service, esp. seizure for public services or works.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:1:30">Y. Ber. I, 2ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>איתצדית בא׳ וכ׳</he> I was pressed into service to carry myrtles &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 6:3">B. Mets. VI, 3</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Metzia 78a:6">78ᵃ</cite>) <he>נעשית א׳</he> (the ass) was seized for public service. Ib. 78ᵇ <he>בא׳ חוזרת</he> in the case that the animal pressed into service is sent back again.
Lev. R. s. 12 שמעון א׳ במדינתא they heard that seizure for public service was to take place in the country. Esth. R. introd. והלך זו א׳ hălakh (Ezra IV, 13) means angaria (v. אנגרוטינא).
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 23">Lev. R. s. 23</cite> <he>אע״פ שהן נגבין … וא׳</he> though annonæ and angariæ are collected from them.
Yalk. Esth. 1051 א׳ של נשים levies of women (for the king).—Trnsf. בא׳ as a forced labor, reluctantly.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 112">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXII</cite>.—
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 21:1">Pesik. R. s. 21</cite> <he>שלא באנגריס</he> (corr. acc.) not as a forced labor.
